name: lib_fib_sq_modEq_neg_one_pow
informal: Cassini's identity as a congruence: F_n^2 ≡ (-1)^(n+1) modulo F_(n+1); in particular F_n^4 ≡ 1 (mod F_(n+1)). Sharpens Mathlib2.p3_cor1_aux1 / p3_cor1_aux2 (squared Cassini), which re-derive Cassini although Mathlib2.an_cassini_int exists (also re-proved as p3_aux_period_aux1 and r3_fib_iff_five_sq_pm_four_is_square_s1h1).
